verdicts.note: Telling the transcriber to include all dialogue describes the transcription process and cannot be checked from text alone (G-5).
Transcripts must include speaker names, which is a flaggable text formatting requirement.
Breaking caption lines at natural syntactic breaks is a distinct check from line length limits.
Starting each line with a dash in a two-speaker subtitle is a distinct check from splitting speakers across lines.
Prescribing an ellipsis for trailing off or unfinished speech in subtitles is a distinct punctuation check.
Lead-in sentence introducing a list of rules for italicisation (G-1).
Lead-in sentence grouping the required elements listed below it (G-1).
Advising the writer to include keywords in titles is SEO advice, not a text rule (G-5).
Advising the writer that titles should be descriptive is general writing guidance (G-5).
Guidance on what information to include in descriptions for series content is advice to the writer (G-5).
Governs the visual line layout of graphic overlays (lower thirds) in video.
Instructing the writer to be correct is general advice that cannot be tested on text (G-5).
Instructing text to be as short as possible is subjective writing advice (G-5).
